segments.text: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
“Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?
Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: and wander for lack of food?
segments.speaker: Yahweh
